d: Russia is reportedly increasingly targeting Ukraine using North Korean ballistic missiles. According to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, Russia fired the KN-23 short-range ballistic missile that has reportedly been supplied to Russia by North Korea in the hundreds. According to Ukrainian residents, the KN-23 missiles were seen flying into targets while leaving behind a 'comet-trail' of parts. The KN-23 resembles the Russian Iskander-M missile and is now being extensively used in the war in Ukraine. This comes after Russian President Vladimir Putin and North Korean Leader Kim Jong Un…
